## Frequently asked questions

### How do I get my team to use this?

You send email invites to your team from inside Salesflare. Setup only takes a few minutes. Once your setup is complete, team members keep sending emails and scheduling meetings as usual – Salesflare will capture this activity and make it trackable for the whole team.

### Can I purchase for one month?

Yes, you can. Licenses for Salesflare are either billed monthly or annually. Monthly pricing is slightly more expensive, so if you are committed to improve your sales productivity: go for the annual plan. There is always a free trial!

### Do you charge for onboarding us?

No. Getting onboarded properly is key to your long term success with Salesflare and we are 100% here to help you with it, entirely free of charge. We're even happy to organize a one-on-one training session for your whole team. Just ask for it [on the chat](mailto:support@salesflare.com).

### Are there any features we need to pay extra for?

The pricing plans are exactly as listed above. There will be no features we will suddenly charge you extra for that will not be listed on this page. We consider these kinds of business practices to be deeply disrespectful to you as a customer.

### Are there any limits to the amount of contacts I can have?

In Salesflare, there are no hidden limits to the amount of contacts, users, email templates, tracked emails, sent emails, custom fields, workflows, dashboards, or even sales pipelines. We won't hit you with any unexpected financial surprises.

### What happens at the end of my trial?

We’ll notify you via email before your trial ends. If you become a paying customer, you don't need to make a new account. You can keep working with your account and all its data that you added during the trial period. Additionally, we’ll help you and your team to get fully onboarded and up to speed... for free.

### What is the cancellation policy?

You can cancel your ongoing plan whenever you want and you’ll stop being charged immediately. There is no need to sign a multi-year contract, or to alert us months before the next renewal.

data.title: What is included in the Pro plan?
data.description:
Salesflare

# What is included in the Pro plan?
Salesflare currently offers three plans: Growth, Pro, and Enterprise.

# Growth
The Growth plan includes all the features you’d expect of a CRM as well as the ability to:

- automate your CRM data input
- track emails, links, and website visits
- use a fully functional sidebar and mobile app
- send personalized email campaigns
- 5 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month

Pricing for the Growth plan is $29/user/month billed annually or $39/user/month billed monthly.

This plan works best for single users or smaller teams who are looking for an easy and automated way to keep track of their sales, don’t want to send multi-step email workflows, do not require [privacy settings](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/4664889-can-i-set-user-permissions) internally, and are content with the standard dashboards in the [Insights](https://app.salesflare.com/#/insights/revenue) tab.

# Pro
- the ability to create and send multi-step email [workflows](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/3749723-how-do-i-send-an-email-workflow)
- 100 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month

Pricing for the Pro plan is $49/user/month billed annually or $64/user/month billed monthly.

This plan works best for larger teams with varying levels of hierarchy who want to have more control over who sees or can change what. If you want to save time doing email reach out/follow-ups, or if you want to generate more insights from your sales and customer data.

# Enterprise
- Custom training for your team
- Your data migration done for you
- A dedicated account manager
- 250 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month

Pricing for the Enterprise plan is $99/user/month billed annually or $124/user/month billed monthly.

Questions? Send us a chat! 😀

Salesflare currently offers three plans: Growth, Pro, and Enterprise.

![](https://howto.salesflare.com/assets/11e3db61689ae68a2b234365.webp)

You can select your plan and payment frequency when signing up, or change it at any time in [Settings > Billing & Usage > Overview](https://app.salesflare.com/#/settings/billing/overview) by selecting ‘update plan’.

* * *

# Growth

The Growth plan includes all the features you’d expect of a CRM as well as the ability to:

- automate your CRM data input

- track emails, links, and website visits

- use a fully functional sidebar and mobile app

- send personalized email campaigns

- 5 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month


Pricing for the Growth plan is $29/user/month billed annually or $39/user/month billed monthly.

This plan works best for single users or smaller teams who are looking for an easy and automated way to keep track of their sales, don’t want to send multi-step email workflows, do not require [privacy settings](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/4664889-can-i-set-user-permissions) internally, and are content with the standard dashboards in the [Insights](https://app.salesflare.com/#/insights/revenue) tab.

You can [purchase more lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/6104352-can-i-buy-more-lead-credits) if need be.

* * *

# Pro

The Pro plan is the most popular choice due to its range of features and customization options. The Pro plan includes:

- **ALL** the features included on the Growth plan and listed above.

- the ability to create and send multi-step email [workflows](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/3749723-how-do-i-send-an-email-workflow)

- the ability to [set user permissions](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/4664889-can-i-set-user-permissions) and

- the possibility of creating [custom insights dashboards](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5511505-how-can-i-make-custom-dashboards-reports)

- 100 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month


Pricing for the Pro plan is $49/user/month billed annually or $64/user/month billed monthly.

This plan works best for larger teams with varying levels of hierarchy who want to have more control over who sees or can change what. If you want to save time doing email reach out/follow-ups, or if you want to generate more insights from your sales and customer data.

You can [purchase more lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/6104352-can-i-buy-more-lead-credits) if need be.

* * *

# Enterprise

The Enterprise plan includes:

- ALL the features included on the Pro plan

- Custom training for your team

- Your data migration done for you

- A dedicated account manager

- 250 [lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/5797397-can-i-find-email-addresses-for-contacts-in-salesflare) per month


Pricing for the Enterprise plan is $99/user/month billed annually or $124/user/month billed monthly. For more information about the Enterprise plan, please contact us at support@salesflare.com

You can [purchase more lead credits](https://howto.salesflare.com/en/articles/6104352-can-i-buy-more-lead-credits) if need be.

* * *

Questions? Send us a chat! 😀

Just reach out to our support team on the chat, here or inside Salesflare.

[Open the chat →](mailto:support@salesflare.com)
